description: Information bulletin [oil] [1997 - 2020] is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Energy. The purpose of an Information Bulletin is to notify industry regarding items such as proposed changes to legislation, regulations or operating procedures with the intent of soliciting feedback; new programs or changes to existing programs, projects, services, strategies or organizational structures; and industry participation in department initiatives. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Energy. Its tags are natural gas royalties, oil. It offers 72 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, URI. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
